title: Soundness of write decoding
statement: If the optional-write reader succeeds on a bit string $x$, returning an optional work-tape write $b$ and suffix $r$, then $x$ is the two-bit encoding of $b$ followed by $r$.
hypotheses_covered: The optional-write reader returns b and r on input x
replaced:
If the optional-write reader succeeds on a bit string $x$, returning a value
$b$ and a suffix $r$, then $x$ is exactly the two-bit dictionary code of $b$
followed by $r$.
